Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - node 'inference-gpu-07' reported CUDA OOM while headroom shows ~900MB free. Auto-suppress attempted fallbacks but requests are flapping. Paging/mitigation channeling here.

Kai Patel: I'm on it. Brief: OOM triggered in runtime allocator during long chat request -- model kv-cache growth + fragmented reserved blocks. Customers hitting 502s. @Sophie can you confirm impact list?

Sophie Lao: Checking CS dashboard now. At least 4 tenants (tier:standard) saw 502 spike starting ~02:12 UTC, ~15-22% error rate on that node's route. No data exfiltration. I'll open a ticket and ping affected accounts.

Maria Gonzales: Logs show repeated "cudaMalloc failed: out of memory" but free memory reported by our monitor (headroom) stayed ~800-1GB. Suspect fragmentation / pinned reserved blocks. Dumping allocator snapshot.

Leo Zhang: Copy. Uploading allocator dump to tmp. Key lines:
```
[allocator] total_reserved: 4096MB
[allocator] reserved_free_chunks: 812MB
[allocator] pinned_blocks: 3 x 256MB
[kv_cache] active_prefixes: 6 -> growth + spike
[error] cudaMalloc(512MB) failed at serve_loop.cc:421: OOM
```

Kai Patel: Ok that aligns with fragment+pin. Two immediate mitigations: 1) force-evict KV prefixes on that worker, 2) scale down model instances on that node and migrate traffic to dedicated fallback pool. Which one is faster?

Leo Zhang: Force-evict KV is quick (API call) but might cause higher latency for in-progress sessions. Migration requires routing change and can be 2-3 mins to drain. I'd run evict first.

Kai Patel: Go for evict + temporary soft-drain. Command to evict:
```
curl -s -X POST "https://internal-admin.redwood/api/v1/nodes/inference-gpu-07/evict_kv" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"threshold_mb":256}'
```

Deploy Bot: Eviction request queued by Kai. Job id: evict-1793456789-1. Will report when complete.

Maria Gonzales: Also toggling allocator flag to enable 'allow_spill_to_host' on that node. This will allow big allocations to spill to host pinned memory (slower but prevents OOM). Command:
```
ssh infra@inference-gpu-07 sudo sysctl -w runtime.allow_spill_to_host=1
```

Oncall Bot: Action log: evict job started, sysctl toggled. ETA for evict ~30s.

Deploy Bot: Evict job evict-1793456789-1 completed: 6 prefixes evicted, released ~680MB.

Leo Zhang: Post-evict allocator snapshot:
```
reserved_free_chunks: 1492MB
pinned_blocks: 2 x 256MB
kv_cache active_prefixes: 1
```

Kai Patel: Nice. Monitoring traffic. Currently error rate dropped from 18% -> 3% on that route.

Sophie Lao: Customer Ops update sent. Affected tenants notified with temporary mitigation note and ETA for full fix.

Maria Gonzales: We still saw one container restart during the event; crash likely from async reserve attempt during heavy GC. Adding quick patch to avoid concurrent reserve while evict in flight. Pushing hotfix to canary.

Deploy Bot: Hotfix canary deployed to pool-canary-3. Health checks passing.

Kai Patel: Rolling patch to runtime on that node to change reserve_blocks from 3->2 temporarily and enable smaller chunk allocation (16MB -> 8MB). This should reduce fragmentation. Rolling now.

Leo Zhang: Rolling completed on inference-gpu-07. Observability: memory alloc efficiency improved, no new OOMs in last 7m.

Oncall Bot: Handing off incident to next oncall: @Sophie for containment + customer comms, @Maria for root cause analysis. Marking current oncall (Kai) as responder -> followup.

Sophie Lao: Taking handoff. I'll keep monitoring for 30m and coordinate RCA doc.

Maria Gonzales: Preliminary root cause: allocator's reserved_block placement combined with large kv-cache growth from a rare user workload caused high fragmentation. Headroom metric measured contiguous free memory inaccurately when many small free chunks existed. Proposed longer-term fixes:
- improve allocator coalescing
- reduce default reserve_blocks on 80GB cards
- add proactive prefix eviction when reserve falls under threshold
- add metric for contiguous_free_bytes

Kai Patel: Agreed. Also adding mitigation: enable model-level fallback to smaller quantized variant when node-level fragmentation is high. Will track rollout in Optimize.

Customer Ops Bot: CS update: affected tenants notified (4 accounts). No SLA credits issued yet; waiting on postmortem.

Sophie Lao: Creating incident tracker: https://redwood.incidents/1793456789

Leo Zhang: I'll attach allocator dump + nvidia-smi snapshot to the tracker. nvidia-smi output at peak:
```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| NVIDIA-SMI 535.86       Driver Version: 535.86       
| GPU 0: 16129MiB / 16384MiB | Util: 72%
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

Kai Patel: Final note: Evict + sysctl spill + reserve reduction contained the issue. No additional nodes affected. Keeping this open for RCA and follow-up tasks. :white_check_mark:

Oncall Bot: Incident status -> CONTAINED. Next update scheduled in 45m.
